registers.exit: Unchanged — unconscious and interrogated, not an agent of knowledge here.
registers.unchanged_because: He is drugged and being broken; the scene gives him no reception of new information, only resistance.

registers.entry: Captain of the ship, the crew's moral anchor.
registers.change: Becomes the object the crew must decide over — Tank moves to kill him, Neo and Trinity move to save him.
registers.exit: The reason the trio re-forms and re-enters; his survival now depends entirely on them.

registers.entry: Not available — unconscious.
registers.change: Not available.
registers.exit: Not available — his only observable output is silence and a sneer under torture.
registers.unchanged_because: No legible emotion is shown; per instruction, no inner life is invented.

registers.entry: Ship's captain and crew leader.
registers.change: Reduced from commander to 'corpse-to-be' / specimen — an object others act around.
registers.exit: Unchanged — still nominally captain but functionally powerless, awaiting rescue.
registers.unchanged_because: His status has already collapsed to captive; this event does not further degrade it.

registers.entry: Aboard the ship, having just survived the betrayal.
registers.change: Re-enters the Matrix via the drive chair; arms himself in the construct with guns.
registers.exit: Jacked into the Matrix, armed, on the way to the rescue.

registers.entry: On the main deck among the survivors.
registers.change: Moves from bystander to mission leader; leaves the ship (mentally) for the Matrix.
registers.exit: Inside the Matrix, leading the rescue with Trinity.

registers.entry: Ignorant of what the Agents are doing to Morpheus and what they want.
registers.change: Learns the Agents are breaking into Morpheus's mind for Zion's mainframe codes that could destroy Zion.
registers.exit: Informed of the stakes; knows Morpheus will talk once his alpha pattern reorders.

registers.entry: Novice, still defined by others' belief that he is the One.
registers.change: Confesses to Trinity he is not the One; Trinity nonetheless commits to him; becomes the trio's acting leader in Morpheus's absence.
registers.exit: Bound to Trinity by shared mission; positioned as Morpheus's would-be rescuer.

registers.entry: Horrified newcomer watching a man tortured toward betrayal.
registers.change: Moves from paralysis to a hard, self-authored certainty ('I believe I can bring him back').
registers.exit: Resolved and confident ('That's why it's going to work'), having converted dread into purpose.

registers.entry: The One (as believed by the crew).
registers.change: Renounces being the One ('I'm just another guy'), yet assumes command of the rescue.
registers.exit: No longer the prophesied One but a self-chosen actor; his authority now rests on belief, not prophecy.

state_triples.reading: Neo's pivot is the event's engine: belief replaces prophecy as the story's motive force.

registers.entry: Awake aboard the ship, reconnected to the crew.
registers.change: Re-enters the Matrix via the drive chair; arms herself in the construct.
registers.exit: Jacked into the Matrix alongside Neo, armed.

registers.entry: Crew member grieving on the main deck.
registers.change: Asserts her rank as ranking officer to override Neo and command the rescue.
registers.exit: Ranking officer leading the mission; no longer left behind.

registers.entry: Unaware of Dozer's death and Cypher's betrayal's full cost.
registers.change: Learns of the casualties (Dozer gone, Cypher the traitor) and of the Agents' plan for the codes.
registers.exit: Informed of the stakes; knows Morpheus is doomed unless rescued.

registers.entry: Devoted to Morpheus and to Neo as the One.
registers.change: Redirects fury onto Cypher's corpse; then, when Neo renounces the One, commits to Neo anyway — her faith relocates from prophecy to the man.
registers.exit: Bound to Neo by choice, not prophecy; re-anchored with him as the surviving core of the trio.

registers.entry: Anxious dread, bracing for Morpheus's death.
registers.change: Explodes into rage at Cypher's body, then shock at Neo's confession, then converts vertigo into authority.
registers.exit: Steeled and commanding, masking unsaid feeling behind rank and duty.

registers.entry: Second-in-command / crew member.
registers.change: Invokes ranking-officer authority to seize command of the mission.
registers.exit: De facto commander of the rescue operation.

state_triples.reading: Trinity's commitment survives the removal of the prophecy, revealing her faith was in Neo, not the One.

registers.entry: Operating the ship with charred wounds from Cypher's betrayal.
registers.change: Covers the dead (his brother Dozer and others); later sits by Morpheus, takes his hand.
registers.exit: Wounded but functional; loading Neo and Trinity into the Matrix, then keeping vigil over Morpheus.

registers.entry: Ship's operator, grieving his brother.
registers.change: Resolves to kill Morpheus to protect Zion; then, overruled by Trinity's rank, shifts to loading the rescue.
registers.exit: Operator supporting the rescue; returns to Morpheus's side to urge him to hold on.

registers.entry: Knows the betrayal's outcome (Cypher's treachery, Dozer's death).
registers.change: Explains the interrogation mechanics (alpha pattern) and the stakes (Zion's codes) to Neo and Trinity.
registers.exit: Unchanged — he is the informed party teaching the others.
registers.unchanged_because: Tank already knows the situation; this event has him imparting knowledge, not gaining it.

registers.entry: Operator loyal to Morpheus, whom he calls a father.
registers.change: Chooses to kill Morpheus out of duty to Zion; then submits to Trinity's command to load the rescue.
registers.exit: Loyal operator again, now serving the rescue and keeping watch over Morpheus.

registers.entry: Freshly gutted by his brother's death.
registers.change: Channels grief into hard protective duty (killing Morpheus); grief works underneath while duty wins aloud.
registers.exit: Resolved to support the mission despite believing it suicidal; returns to mourning Morpheus.

registers.entry: Ship's operator under Morpheus.
registers.change: Temporarily becomes the decision-maker on Morpheus's life; then yields authority to Trinity as ranking officer.
registers.exit: Operator again, subordinate to Trinity's command.

state_triples.reading: Tank's 'pull the plug' is grief weaponized as duty; his compliance with Trinity shows rank overriding his own judgment.

registers.entry: Interrogating Morpheus by serum and monitors.
registers.change: Escalates to physical torture (gripping and squeezing Morpheus's head); wipes sweat onto Morpheus; removes his earphone.
registers.exit: Physically engaged in coercion, overcome by anger and disgust — a state 'not supposed to happen to Agents'.

registers.entry: Lead interrogator working with Brown and Jones as a team.
registers.change: Dismisses Brown and Jones to be alone with Morpheus; pursues a personal, unauthorized goal.
registers.exit: Isolated from the other Agents, acting on his own will to escape the Matrix.

registers.entry: Confident the interrogation is under control; treats Morpheus as a specimen.
registers.change: Learns the serum is failing; Jones reports 'There could be a problem'; concludes Morpheus's allies are dead.
registers.exit: Aware the operation is slipping but proceeds regardless, deploying sentinels.

registers.entry: Agent serving the system, contemptuous of humanity.
registers.change: Confesses hatred for the Matrix and fear of being 'infected' by humanity; reveals a personal motive (escape) that separates him from the system's aims.
registers.exit: In covert revolt against the system he enforces; his goal is now personal freedom, not just extraction.

registers.entry: Cold, aesthetic self-satisfaction in the machine worldview.
registers.change: Mounting anger and disgust experienced as contamination; relish in pronouncing humans 'a disease' and the Agents 'the cure'.
registers.exit: Overcome by rage and loathing; his composure cracking in ways the other Agents notice.

registers.entry: Commanding Agent of the interrogation.
registers.change: His authority frays — Brown questions his method, and his own emotions mark him as malfunctioning in his subordinates' eyes.
registers.exit: Still nominally in command but visibly compromised; pursuing a private agenda.

state_triples.reading: Smith's mask slips from system-enforcer to a will in revolt, personalizing the antagonist and foreshadowing his later independence.

registers.entry: Arriving by helicopter with Marines at the government building.
registers.change: Enters the interrogation with a warning; participates in the deliberation; deploys sentinels.
registers.exit: Executing the decision to proceed and attack physically.

registers.entry: Reporting from the field.
registers.change: Registers that something has moved outside the plan ('There could be a problem'); concludes Morpheus's allies are dead.
registers.exit: Aware of a threat he cannot yet fully name; proceeds on the assumption the insiders are dead.

registers.entry: Subordinate reporting to Smith.
registers.change: Interrupts Smith's control with a warning; shares a doubting glance with Brown before obeying Smith's order to leave.
registers.exit: Still obedient but watchfully suspicious of Smith.

registers.entry: Alert, unsettled by something off-plan.
registers.change: Unease grows as Smith comes apart; defers to Brown's read.
registers.exit: Unchanged — watchful suspicion, no further expression.
registers.unchanged_because: Jones shows only a shared glance and silent departure; his emotional state does not advance beyond suspicion.

registers.entry: Field Agent under Smith.
registers.change: Unchanged — remains a subordinate throughout.
registers.exit: Unchanged — still subordinate, now doubting but compliant.
registers.unchanged_because: Jones's rank and role do not change in this event; only his private suspicion shifts.

registers.entry: On the roof of the government building with Marines.
registers.change: Moves inside to the maintenance level, then into the interrogation room.
registers.exit: Inside the executive office with the other Agents and Morpheus.

state_triples.reading: Jones is the first crack in the Agents' certainty — his warning signals control slipping before anyone can name why.

registers.entry: Interrogating Morpheus by serum and monitors.
registers.change: Escalates to physical torture (gripping and squeezing Morpheus's head); wipes sweat onto Morpheus; removes his earphone.
registers.exit: Physically engaged in coercion, overcome by anger and disgust — a state 'not supposed to happen to Agents'.

registers.entry: Lead interrogator working with Brown and Jones as a team.
registers.change: Dismisses Brown and Jones to be alone with Morpheus; pursues a personal, unauthorized goal.
registers.exit: Isolated from the other Agents, acting on his own will to escape the Matrix.

registers.entry: Confident the interrogation is under control; treats Morpheus as a specimen.
registers.change: Learns the serum is failing; Jones reports 'There could be a problem'; concludes Morpheus's allies are dead.
registers.exit: Aware the operation is slipping but proceeds regardless, deploying sentinels.

registers.entry: Agent serving the system, contemptuous of humanity.
registers.change: Confesses hatred for the Matrix and fear of being 'infected' by humanity; reveals a personal motive (escape) that separates him from the system's aims.
registers.exit: In covert revolt against the system he enforces; his goal is now personal freedom, not just extraction.

registers.entry: Cold, aesthetic self-satisfaction in the machine worldview.
registers.change: Mounting anger and disgust experienced as contamination; relish in pronouncing humans 'a disease' and the Agents 'the cure'.
registers.exit: Overcome by rage and loathing; his composure cracking in ways the other Agents notice.

registers.entry: Commanding Agent of the interrogation.
registers.change: His authority frays — Brown questions his method, and his own emotions mark him as malfunctioning in his subordinates' eyes.
registers.exit: Still nominally in command but visibly compromised; pursuing a private agenda.

state_triples.reading: Smith's mask slips from system-enforcer to a will in revolt, personalizing the antagonist and foreshadowing his later independence.

registers.entry: Dead aboard the ship from the betrayal's aftermath.
registers.change: Unchanged — his corpse is discovered and kicked by Trinity.
registers.exit: Unchanged — remains dead; his body is a target for Trinity's rage.
registers.unchanged_because: Cypher is already dead; the event only uses his corpse as an emotional trigger.

registers.entry: Dead on the main deck.
registers.change: Unchanged — position unchanged; his body is covered along with the others.
registers.exit: Unchanged — a corpse among the covered dead.
registers.unchanged_because: He has no agency; his position is fixed by death.

registers.entry: Not applicable — dead.
registers.change: Unchanged — not a knowing agent.
registers.exit: Unchanged.
registers.unchanged_because: Dead; no knowledge register applies.

registers.entry: The traitor whose betrayal caused the crisis.
registers.change: Unchanged in himself, but his betrayal is now the established cause the crew reacts to.
registers.exit: Unchanged — remembered only as the cause of their ruin.
registers.unchanged_because: His relational role is fixed by his prior betrayal; the event does not alter it.

registers.entry: Not applicable — dead.
registers.change: Unchanged.
registers.exit: Unchanged.
registers.unchanged_because: Dead; no emotion register applies.

registers.entry: Traitor / dead crew member.
registers.change: Unchanged — status fixed by death and betrayal.
registers.exit: Unchanged — contemptible traitor, now dead.
registers.unchanged_because: His status is sealed by death; the event adds nothing.

state_triples.reading: Cypher is a fixed cause, not a participant — his corpse is spent as fuel for Trinity's rage.

affects_outside.how: The Agents now hold Morpheus, the only path to Zion's mainframe codes; if he breaks, Zion falls. This raises the stakes of the entire Zion plotline and sets the clock for the coming assault.

Having concluded Morpheus's allies are dead, the Agents deploy the sentinels to attack the ship physically — escalating the conflict from a mental interrogation to a real-world threat against the Nebuchadnezzar.
His confession of hatred and his private goal of escape plant the seed of his independence from the system, which pays off in later events.
By acting on self-authored belief rather than prophecy, Neo crosses the threshold that will transform him — the rescue is the crucible of his becoming.

events.turns_on: Neo's refusal to accept the crew's fatalistic choice (kill Morpheus) and his decision to act on belief he cannot logically justify.
events.boundary_reason: From Neo and Trinity's brief reunion through the crew's grief, the Agents' escalating interrogation, and finally Neo's decision to go back in, these scenes form one continuous response to Morpheus's capture. The situation stays fixed on the same problem — Morpheus is taken, the crew must react — until Neo commits to the rescue and the plan begins to load.

events.title: The Assault on the Government Building
events.summary: Neo and Trinity storm the government building to reach and extract Morpheus before the Agents can move him. They blast through the lobby, rig the elevator for a shaft ascent, and fight their way to the roof, where an Agent ambushes them; Trinity destroys it and they reach the extraction helicopter, loading a pilot program to escape. The assault forces the Agents to recognize the rescue, commit their full response, and — too late — lose both their prisoner's leverage and the rebels themselves.
events.action: Neo and Trinity breach the government building's lobby and gun down the checkpoint guards and the soldiers sent to contain them, then stop the elevator and wire it with a napalm-plastique bomb while Neo opens an escape route into the shaft. They sever the elevator cable so the counterweights haul them to the top as the rigged car explodes in the lobby below. On the roof they clear the last marines, but the helicopter pilot is overwritten by Agent Jones, who nearly kills Neo before Trinity executes the Agent at point-blank range. Trinity then has Tank load a B-212 helicopter pilot program into her so they can fly the extraction craft away.

registers.entry: Entering the government building lobby as a screened suspect at a checkpoint.
registers.change: Converts from suspect to the leading edge of the rescue: kills the guards, fights through the lobby, ascends the elevator shaft, and reaches the roof.
registers.exit: On the roof, wounded but mobile, then helped up by Trinity and moving toward the helicopter.

registers.entry: Whole, carrying a duffel bag and an arsenal on a climbing harness.
registers.change: Grazed by the Agent's fire — one bullet shears his shoulder, another cuts his thigh.
registers.exit: Wounded but functional: checks the shoulder, insists he is fine, keeps moving.

registers.entry: Believes he can walk through the building unharmed and that an Agent can be killed by outgunning it.
registers.change: Learns his guns have no effect on an Agent and that he can now move at Agent-speed — while also learning that speed is still not enough, as he is cut open.
registers.exit: Holding both facts at once: proof he is more than ordinary, proof he is not yet enough ('It wasn't fast enough').

registers.entry: The protected lead, having objected to Trinity joining the mission.
registers.change: Saved by Trinity at the decisive moment; his new capability witnessed and re-read by her.
registers.exit: Still operating as a unit with Trinity, but now under her read as possibly what Morpheus claimed.

registers.entry: Cold, deliberate certainty — committed to being seen as a threat.
registers.change: Certainty breached by being wounded; replaces open aggression with brusque denial of injury.
registers.exit: Quietly terrified beneath the 'I'm fine,' deflecting Trinity's wonder with self-criticism.

registers.entry: A suspect under routine screening.
registers.change: Becomes the object of an active Agent counter-response and, internally, a threshold-crosser.
registers.exit: A proven-but-incomplete anomaly the Agents must now hunt and destroy.

state_triples.reading: Neo's arc in the event is the conversion of preparation into irreversible action and the simultaneous proof and limitation of his power — he arrives as a suspect and leaves as a near-Agent who is still, demonstrably, 'only human' by his own measure.

registers.entry: Entering the lobby as co-lead of the breach, carrying a metal suitcase.
registers.change: Fights in lockstep with Neo, wires the elevator bomb, ascends the shaft, clears the roof, and executes the Agent.
registers.exit: On the roof, taking initiative: steadies Neo, assesses the helicopter, and calls Tank for a pilot program.

registers.entry: Staking her competence to answer Neo's earlier doubt.
registers.change: Discovers and applies the method to destroy an Agent (point-blank shot) and witnesses Neo move at Agent-speed.
registers.exit: Holding the practical knowledge that Agents can be killed and the reverent alarm that Neo may be what Morpheus claimed.

registers.entry: The would-be equal whose rank Neo questioned.
registers.change: Becomes Neo's savior and the one who reads his transformation.
registers.exit: Positioned above Neo in this moment — protector, interpreter, and the one planning the escape.

registers.entry: Asserting herself as an active operator, not backup.
registers.change: Proves it: ends the Agent threat and drives the extraction.
registers.exit: Confirmed as the decisive force keeping the rescue alive.

registers.entry: Whole, armed, carrying the bomb case.
registers.change: Unharmed throughout the assault.
registers.exit: Unharmed — she takes no wound in the event.
registers.unchanged_because: The scenes record no injury to Trinity; she exits the fight physically intact while Neo is the one cut open.

registers.entry: Resolved and synchronized with Neo.
registers.change: Swings from dread (reading the threat in Neo's face) to lethal focus to searching alarm at what Neo has become.
registers.exit: Operational calm layered over a reorganized belief about Neo; conceals what the answer means.

state_triples.reading: Trinity's arc is the assertion of equality made good and then exceeded: she proves her competence, saves Neo, and leaves carrying new knowledge — the method against Agents and a destabilizing belief in what Neo is becoming.

registers.entry: In Agent Smith's custody in the executive office.
registers.change: Held as the target of the incoming rescue; the Agents recognize the rescue is underway.
registers.exit: Still in custody at the end of the recorded scenes — the rescue has not yet reached him.
registers.unchanged_because: No scene in this event shows Morpheus freed or moved; he remains a prisoner while the assault climbs toward the roof.

registers.entry: The captured prize the Agents intend to exploit.
registers.change: Becomes the acknowledged objective of an active attack the Agents must now answer.
registers.exit: Unchanged in immediate condition — still captive — but now the center of a building-wide battle.
registers.unchanged_because: His captivity is not broken within these scenes; only its context (a rescue in progress) changes.

registers.entry: A prisoner, physically held.
registers.change: No physical change recorded.
registers.exit: No physical change recorded.
registers.unchanged_because: The scenes do not show Morpheus acted upon physically; he is discussed as the rescue's target, not touched.

registers.entry: Unknown from these scenes.
registers.change: No change recorded — he is not shown perceiving the rescue.
registers.exit: No change recorded.
registers.unchanged_because: Morpheus has no mind-record or dialogue in these scenes; whether he knows the rescue is underway is not stated.

registers.entry: The reason Neo and Trinity are assaulting the building.
registers.change: No change — his relational role as the one to be saved is constant.
registers.exit: Still the person being rescued.
registers.unchanged_because: His relationship to the rescuers (captive to be freed) is the event's premise, not something altered within it.

registers.entry: Not recorded.
registers.change: No change recorded.
registers.exit: No change recorded.
registers.unchanged_because: No emotional state for Morpheus is observable in these scenes.

state_triples.reading: Morpheus is the static prize around which the event turns — his captivity is the constant that motivates the breach and the Agents' response, but within these scenes he is neither freed nor harmed.

registers.entry: Holding Morpheus, feigning ignorance when the other agents arrive ('Know what?').
registers.change: Receives word via earphone that disbelieves him, then learns the building is under active attack.
registers.exit: Knowing the intruders are attacking and committing to destroy them ('Find them and destroy them!').

registers.entry: Custodian of Morpheus, caught off-guard by his fellow agents.
registers.change: Reasserts command by ordering the hunt as the attack escalates.
registers.exit: The aggressor directing the response, no longer the embarrassed custodian.

registers.entry: Under scrutiny from Jones and Brown for what he was doing with Morpheus.
registers.change: Regains authority by taking charge of the counter-response.
registers.exit: Back in command of the other agents.

registers.entry: Present in the office with Morpheus.
registers.change: Smashes a table in resolve.
registers.exit: Physically intact, directing the hunt.
registers.unchanged_because: His only physical action is the table-smash; he is otherwise unchanged.

registers.entry: In the executive office with Morpheus in custody.
registers.change: Releases Morpheus as the other agents arrive, then remains in the office directing the response.
registers.exit: Still in the executive office, now orchestrating the building-wide hunt.

registers.entry: Composed, masking whatever he was doing with Morpheus.
registers.change: Disbelief at the earphone report, then cold, violent resolve.
registers.exit: Committed to aggressive destruction of the intruders.

state_triples.reading: Smith moves from being caught out by his peers to re-establishing dominance by converting the surprise attack into a target he can hunt — the assault hands him a clear enemy and a clear order.

registers.entry: Arriving in the executive office with Brown to confront Smith.
registers.change: Interprets the explosions as the rescue, then overwrites the rooftop Pilot to intercept the rebels.
registers.exit: On the roof, embodied as the Pilot-turned-Agent, charging Neo.

registers.entry: Watching Morpheus without naming the intruders' intent.
registers.change: Concludes 'they're trying to save him,' then confronts a human who moves at Agent-speed.
registers.exit: Forced to register that Neo is not 'only human' — his certainty breached — before being destroyed.

registers.entry: An interpreter of the situation, nodding to Smith's order to act.
registers.change: Becomes the field interceptor who nearly kills Neo, then is executed by Trinity.
registers.exit: Destroyed — his body reverts to the dead Pilot.

registers.entry: Embodied as an Agent.
registers.change: Charges, is interrupted by Trinity's gun, shot three times at point-blank range.
registers.exit: Body destroyed and reverted to the Pilot's form.

registers.entry: Subordinate reporting to Smith, executing the hunt.
registers.change: Becomes Neo's near-executioner, then Trinity's victim.
registers.exit: Eliminated by Trinity — the rebels have now killed an Agent.

registers.entry: Analytical, confident.
registers.change: Predatory satisfaction curdling into breached certainty when Neo matches his speed and a gun appears at his head.
registers.exit: Denied his finish, destroyed mid-triumph.

state_triples.reading: Jones is the event's escalation-and-reversal figure: he correctly reads the rescue, intercepts the rebels with lethal effect, but is undone by underestimating them — his contempt ('Only human...') is disproved and Trinity kills him.

registers.entry: Demanding to know what Smith was doing, then hearing the building rock.
registers.change: Recognizes the intruders are actively attacking ('They are actually attacking').
registers.exit: Aware the building is under real assault.

registers.entry: Bursting into the office with Jones.
registers.change: No positional change — remains in the office reacting to the escalating attack.
registers.exit: Still in the executive office, registering the attack.
registers.unchanged_because: Brown does not leave the office or take field action in these scenes; he only interprets the alarms.

registers.entry: An agent responding to the situation.
registers.change: No change — he does not issue orders or take command.
registers.exit: Still a reacting subordinate.
registers.unchanged_because: Smith issues the order and Jones acts on it; Brown only registers the reality of the attack.

registers.entry: Present in the office.
registers.change: No physical change recorded.
registers.exit: No physical change recorded.
registers.unchanged_because: Brown performs no physical action beyond reacting to the alarms.

registers.entry: Confronting Smith alongside Jones.
registers.change: No change — defers as Smith takes command.
registers.exit: Still alongside the other agents, not in command.
registers.unchanged_because: Brown's relationship to the other agents is not altered within these scenes.

registers.entry: Demanding, then registering disbelief at the scale of the attack.
registers.change: No further recorded shift.
registers.exit: Still processing that the attack is real.
registers.unchanged_because: No deeper emotional shift for Brown is recorded beyond his recognition of the attack.

state_triples.reading: Brown is the event's confirmation voice — his 'They are actually attacking' marks the moment the Agents collectively recognize the rescue as a real, active assault rather than a nuisance.

registers.entry: Seated at the hovercraft controls, awaiting a request.
registers.change: Locates and loads the B-212 helicopter pilot program into Trinity's supplement drive.
registers.exit: Having supplied the program, enabling Trinity to fly the extraction helicopter.

registers.entry: The operator supporting the field team remotely.
registers.change: Fulfills a time-critical request under pressure.
registers.exit: Still the support operator, having delivered the needed resource.
registers.unchanged_because: His role as operator is constant; only his task state changes.

registers.entry: Aware Trinity needs a pilot program but not why, beyond urgency.
registers.change: No recorded knowledge change — he acts on the request without new understanding.
registers.exit: No recorded knowledge change.
registers.unchanged_because: Tank is not shown learning anything new; he executes a retrieval under time pressure.

registers.entry: Seated at the controls.
registers.change: Fingers moving fast over the laser disks.
registers.exit: Having completed the load; physically unchanged otherwise.
registers.unchanged_because: His only physical action is the rapid disk retrieval and keyboard commands.

registers.entry: Remote support for Trinity and Neo.
registers.change: No change — continues in the support role.
registers.exit: Still the support operator for the extraction.
registers.unchanged_because: Tank's relationship to the field team is constant throughout the event.

registers.entry: Ready and responsive.
registers.change: Urged to hurry; responds with speed.
registers.exit: No recorded emotional shift beyond task urgency.
registers.unchanged_because: No emotional state beyond focused urgency is recorded for Tank.

state_triples.reading: Tank is the event's logistical hinge — his loading of the pilot program is what converts the rooftop survival into a viable escape, spending the crew's disk resources to enable the exfiltration.

registers.entry: In control of the checkpoint, able to issue routine screening orders.
registers.change: Three killed instantly by Neo; a fourth killed after his backup call fails to save him.
registers.exit: All dead — the checkpoint neutralized.

registers.entry: Armed, standing at the detector.
registers.change: Shot down before or as they react; the fourth dies looking up at Trinity.
registers.exit: Bodies slumped on the marbled floor.

registers.entry: Believing the two odd visitors are compliant civilians.
registers.change: Realize too late this is an ambush, not a screening.
registers.exit: Dead — the realization comes only as they die.

registers.entry: Stationed at the security checkpoint.
registers.change: Killed at their posts; the fourth dives for cover then is killed.
registers.exit: No longer holding any position — the checkpoint is overrun.

registers.entry: Routine screeners facing two visitors.
registers.change: Become the first casualties of the rescue — their deaths summon the soldiers.
registers.exit: The dead whose killing escalates the building's response.

registers.entry: A flicker of unease beneath routine procedure.
registers.change: Survival panic as the ambush becomes clear.
registers.exit: Dead — no further emotional state.

state_triples.reading: The guards are the event's first escalation rung — their swift killing converts a routine screening into a firefight and, by triggering the backup call, summons the soldiers who raise the stakes.

registers.entry: Reinforcements sent to contain the intruders at the elevators.
registers.change: Cut down by Neo and Trinity's precise weapons fire.
registers.exit: Dead — the containment failed.

registers.entry: A wave of armed soldiers with explosive-tipped rounds.
registers.change: Mowed down in the lobby's crossfire.
registers.exit: Bodies on the floor; the elevator approach cleared.

registers.entry: Believing two intruders can be pinned by overwhelming firepower in an open lobby.
registers.change: Outmatched by precision and synchronization that turns the open space against them.
registers.exit: Dead — their assumption disproved.

registers.entry: Blocking the elevators as a mass response.
registers.change: Cut down before they can hold the position.
registers.exit: The elevator approach left open for Neo and Trinity.

registers.entry: The government's heavier response to the breach.
registers.change: Become the second wave of casualties.
registers.exit: Eliminated — the building's conventional defense breached.

registers.entry: Confident in a mass response.
registers.change: Overwhelmed before the confidence can matter.
registers.exit: Dead.

state_triples.reading: The soldiers are the event's second escalation rung — heavier weaponry that the scene frames as a real test of Neo and Trinity's certainty, and which they pass, clearing the way to the elevators.

registers.entry: An army-helicopter pilot reporting the attack over the radio.
registers.change: Overwritten by Agent Jones ('his whole body dissolves... as Agent Jones emerges').
registers.exit: Restored to his own dead body when the Agent is destroyed.

registers.entry: A living pilot at the helicopter.
registers.change: Body consumed by the Agent, then reverted when Trinity kills the Agent.
registers.exit: Dead — his body lands on the roof after the Agent's destruction.

registers.entry: At the rooftop helicopter, radioing for help.
registers.change: Becomes the Agent, charges Neo, is shot, and falls back as the Pilot.
registers.exit: Lying dead on the roof.

registers.entry: Aware the roof is under attack.
registers.change: No recorded change — he is overtaken before gaining new understanding.
registers.exit: No recorded change.
registers.unchanged_because: The Pilot is overwritten almost immediately; no internal knowledge shift is shown.

registers.entry: A government asset at the extraction helicopter.
registers.change: Becomes the Agents' ambush vector, then a corpse.
registers.exit: A dead body — the helicopter now uncontrolled by the government.

registers.entry: Reporting under stress.
registers.change: No recorded emotional shift — overtaken too fast.
registers.exit: No recorded emotional state.
registers.unchanged_because: The Pilot's brief appearance shows no distinct emotional change beyond the overwrite.

state_triples.reading: The Pilot is the event's reveal mechanism — his overwrite by Jones demonstrates the Agents' body-hopping nature and delivers the rooftop ambush, and his reversion to a corpse proves Trinity's kill.

affects_outside.what: The Agents' campaign against the Nebuchadnezzar crew
affects_outside.how: The assault forces the Agents to recognize the rescue as real and active, commit their full response ('Find them and destroy them!'), and deploy an Agent to the field — escalating the conflict from custody-holding to open pursuit. It also costs them an Agent's body and, ultimately, their leverage over Morpheus once the rebels escape.

The rooftop fight is the first on-record proof that Neo can move at Agent-speed — a capability gain that later scenes depend on — while the wound and his 'wasn't fast enough' set the remaining gap he must close.

Spends a B-212 helicopter pilot program (loaded into Trinity) and expends a large quantity of ammunition and explosives; the helicopter becomes the extraction vehicle that removes the team — and Morpheus, once reached — from government hands.

affects_outside.what: The government building / the Matrix's authorities
affects_outside.how: The building is left damaged (explosions, fire, sprinklers, a destroyed elevator and rooftop ambush site) and its conventional defenders dead, forcing the Agents to shift from interrogation to a building-wide manhunt.

events.turns_on: The rooftop ambush: whether Neo and Trinity can survive the Agent after clearing the building. Everything before it is the climb; everything after — Neo's proof-and-limit, Trinity's method, the escape — follows from Trinity's point-blank kill of Agent Jones.
events.boundary_reason: The ominous exterior beat launches the execution of the rescue plan. From the lobby firefight through the elevator shaft ascent, the roof battle with Agent Jones, and the helicopter pilot program, every scene is one continuous action — breaking into the building to reach Morpheus — cutting between the attackers and the reacting Agents as a single unit.

events.title: Helicopter Assault, Morpheus's Rescue, and the Crash
events.summary: Trinity downloads the ability to fly a helicopter and flies it to a government building, where Neo guns down the three Agents from the gunship bay, revives and extracts the handcuffed Morpheus, and then — after Smith reconstitutes and shoots Morpheus mid-escape — catches Morpheus's falling wrist. Trinity flies the pair off, but Smith shoots the helicopter down; the tether that saved Morpheus nearly drags Neo over the edge, Trinity severs it, and the machine explodes as the team is stranded on a rooftop. The event converts Neo from rooftop prey into the rescuer who commands overwhelming force, completes Morpheus's extraction, and ends by trading a clean escape for a survivable catastrophe that strands the heroes and hands Smith a pyrrhic win.
events.action: the rescue of Morpheus by helicopter assault and the crash that strands the team

registers.entry: Unable to fly the helicopter ('Not yet').
registers.change: Absorbs the essentials of flying at light-speed via a download.
registers.exit: Able to fly the helicopter.

registers.entry: On the roof with Neo, about to depart.
registers.change: Flies the helicopter to the government building, then away from it; lunges for the back door, grabs the rope, fires to sever the cord, and swings on the rope to a shatterproof window as the helicopter explodes.
registers.exit: Alive but stranded, hanging on a rope against a spider-cracked window after the helicopter is destroyed.

registers.entry: In control of the extraction as pilot.
registers.change: The plan collapses into improvisation when Smith shoots the machine down; she trades the dying aircraft for the men and cuts the cord that would drag Neo over the edge.
registers.exit: No longer in a clean escape; she has saved Neo but lost the machine and is left dangling, the flight turned into a catastrophe.

registers.entry: Rooftop prey, nearly killed by Jones moments earlier, dependent on Trinity.
registers.change: Commands the helicopter gunship, destroys all three Agents with the .50 caliber, then physically commits his own body to catch Morpheus mid-fall.
registers.exit: The rescuer who has ascended from victim to agent — but is then dragged off his feet by the very tether he trusted and saved only by Trinity cutting the cord and his own grip on the gutter.

registers.entry: In the back bay of the helicopter, aiming the mounted gun.
registers.change: Attaches a climbing rope to his harness, drops and rolls free onto the roof with Morpheus, is yanked toward the edge by the taut line, and levers himself up on the gutter.
registers.exit: On the rooftop, having survived the crash, but no longer safely aboard the aircraft.

registers.entry: Believes overwhelming force can end the Agents; believes Morpheus can be roused by a shouted command.
registers.change: Learns (implicitly, through action) that destroying the Agents' bodies does not end them and that willpower alone will not rouse Morpheus; learns the tether that saved Morpheus can also kill him.
registers.exit: Still does not understand that Agents reconstitute; his belief in the line as safety has been shaken by the near-disaster.

state_triples.reading: Neo's arc runs from terror to overwhelming agency and back to vulnerability: the same scene that makes him the savior makes him the one who must be saved, binding him to Trinity through the rope she refuses to drop.

registers.entry: Passive, downed, seated and handcuffed, apparently unable to act.
registers.change: Revives — rises, snaps his handcuffs, runs for the window — but is shot in the leg, knocked off balance, falls, is caught by Neo, then dropped and rolled onto the roof.
registers.exit: Wounded (leg), partially freed (one cuff still on his wrist), alive but dependent on others, having survived the fall.

registers.entry: The Agents' prisoner, held in the executive office.
registers.change: Breaks free of the chair and cuffs, escapes the room, and is extracted from the building by the helicopter team.
registers.exit: No longer in Agent custody — rescued — but stranded on a rooftop rather than safely away.

registers.entry: Seated in the executive office.
registers.change: Runs past the open door, dives for the window, falls, is caught by Neo's grip on his handcuffed wrist, then drops and rolls free on the roof.
registers.exit: On the rooftop, having survived the fall, but no longer safely aboard the aircraft.

state_triples.reading: Morpheus's recovery is hard-won and precarious: he regains his will and strength, but the still-handcuffed wrist and the leg wound mark him as only partially free, kept alive by Neo's grip and then by physics he survives rather than masters.

registers.entry: Reconstituted as the helicopter pilot in sc-163, then enters the executive office armed.
registers.change: Is the first Agent hit by the .50 caliber fire — jack-knifes back, blood arcing in a flash of light — and is destroyed.
registers.exit: Body destroyed; as an Agent he can reconstitute elsewhere, but this form is ended.

registers.entry: Overconfident, having just pronounced Neo 'only human' and nearly killed him.
registers.change: Underestimates Neo's ascent and is killed before he can fire.
registers.exit: His belief that Neo is prey is lethally inverted; his current form is destroyed.

state_triples.reading: Jones dies carrying the same arrogance from the rooftop; his destruction is the first proof that the man he dismissed now commands the machines of the Matrix.

events.title: The Agents Arrive Too Late and Order the Strike
events.summary: The three Agents reach the rooftop to find Neo, Trinity and Morpheus already gone; with the trace completed and the fugitives' position confirmed, Jones orders the Sentinel strike. While the strike is set in motion, Morpheus escapes through a subway phone as an unseen old man witnesses the impossible, and Smith—left alone on the roof—snaps from resignation to sudden, hate-twisted alertness at a sound he detects.
events.action: The Agents charge onto the rooftop and discover their quarry has already escaped. Brown reports the trace is complete and Jones confirms they have the position; Jones then orders the Sentinel strike while Smith, unable to tolerate the exchange, withdraws to the building's edge. Simultaneously, in a subway station, Morpheus exits through a ringing phone as a hunched old man watches with eyes that glow white. Back on the rooftop, Smith begins to turn away but is arrested by a sudden sound, his head whipping back.

events.title: The Subway Ambush — Trinity Escapes, Neo Is Trapped
events.summary: Trinity's escape is ambushed at the very phone Neo sends her to, while Neo is left alone in the subway facing Agent Smith at gunpoint. The crew loses its exit and its operator refuses re-entry, stranding Neo with the one Agent who waited in disguise for the moment their guard was lowest.
events.action: Trinity reaches the Oracle's confession and begins to reveal that she was told she would fall in love, but the train drowns her out; Neo closes the booth to send her to safety, only for the old man in the corner to reveal himself as Agent Smith and fire — the shot arriving a beat too late as Trinity jacks out. On the hovercraft Trinity demands to be sent back to Neo, but Tank refuses. In the subway Neo turns from the destroyed phone to find Smith's gun already on him.

events.turns_on: The old man in the corner is Agent Smith in disguise, waiting for the lovers' guard to drop; the escape route Neo sends Trinity to is the very spot of the ambush; Trinity escapes a beat before the bullet, but Neo is left trapped.
events.boundary_reason: The ambush that separates the group (Trinity and Morpheus exit, Neo is cornered by Smith) resolves with Neo turned at gunpoint; the next scene is a reaction beat aboard the hovercraft, shifting to the crew's response rather than the station standoff.

events.title: The Crew Urges Neo to Believe
events.summary: From the main deck, the crew watches Neo through the code and Trinity commands him to run. Neo, alone in the subway station, sheds his hesitation and settles into a gunfighter's present-only focus. Witnessing this on the screens, Morpheus reads the shift aloud: Neo is beginning to believe.
events.action: The crew's remote urging coincides with Neo's internal turn from doubt to resolve, which Morpheus names as the onset of belief.

registers.exit: Settled into present-only focus — 'no past or future, only what is.'

registers.unchanged_because: The escalator is dead and he does not ascend it; the only movement is the slow turn of his body and the hardening of his gaze, so his location and station-position are unchanged.

affects_outside.how: Neo's beginning to believe is the precondition the crew has been waiting for; it advances the plot from a hunted fugitive toward the One who can act, setting up his imminent confrontation and escape.

events.turns_on: Neo's internal shift from doubt to present-only resolve, externally witnessed and named by Morpheus as belief beginning.
events.boundary_reason: Trinity's "Run, Neo" and Morpheus's "He's beginning to believe" form one observation-beat unit focused on Neo's awakening; the next scene returns to the station for the physical fight, restarting action rather than continuing the watching.

events.title: Neo and Smith's Gun-and-Fist Duel to the Train
events.summary: Neo and Agent Smith exhaust their guns in a mirrored standoff, then fight hand to hand through the subway until Smith overpowers and nearly kills Neo on the tracks — where Neo refuses the death Smith authors, hurls Smith into the train's path, and escapes onto the departing car, only for Smith to burst from the last door still in pursuit. The event converts Neo's just-born belief into demonstrated will and power, then immediately reopens the chase by proving Smith survived.
events.action: The duel burns through parity into domination and then into a refusal that reclaims agency — only to be denied closure by the enemy's return.

registers.entry: Armed and matched, sweating and panting but whole, gun jammed to Smith's head.
registers.change: Wounded and battered — a knife-hand opens his forearm, a kick slams him against a column, he is choked until he cannot breathe, hurled against the tunnel wall near the electrified third-rail.
registers.exit: Battered, limping, knees shaking, but alive and mobile — he backflips off the tracks and runs for the escalator.

registers.entry: Locked head-to-head with Smith in a mutual standoff in the subway station.
registers.change: Driven back and pinned against the tunnel wall, then choked on the tracks facing the oncoming train.
registers.exit: Free and elevated — he launches upward off the tracks, backflips clear, and is carried away on the train toward the escalator while Smith is left on the platform.

registers.entry: Believes parity is real — that matching Smith move for move forces an equal and lets him survive on even terms.
registers.change: The illusion of parity is broken twice: Smith discards the rules and overpowers him physically, then survives the train that Neo believed would end him.
registers.exit: Knows Smith is not bound by any rule Neo honors and is not killable by the train — which is why he runs rather than stands.

registers.entry: An equal in a standoff — no longer prey, forcing Smith to meet him as a match.
registers.change: Reduced to prey again as Smith overwhelms him and stages his death.
registers.exit: Reclaimed as an agent — he refuses the death Smith authored ('My name is Neo') and converts nascent belief into a physically impossible act — but remains a fleeing target, not a victor.

registers.entry: Strained and exhausted but holding a flat, unflinching gunfighter's resolve.
registers.change: Terror as the oncoming train makes death inevitable, underlaid by a refusal that catches up with his power.
registers.exit: Resolved and self-possessed — his will overrides physical doom — though his body still trembles.

But the turn is deliberately unfinished — he escapes as a fugitive, not a conqueror.

registers.entry: Machine-calm, armed, and whole, gun jammed to Neo's head.

registers.exit: Intact and undiminished — he bursts from the last car with his glasses again in place, still able to pursue.

state_triples.reading: Smith's fatal flaw — the certainty that a human cannot equal him — is exposed and then punished. His survival restores him as the story's unkillable engine of pursuit, which is what keeps the chase alive toward Neo's death and resurrection.

affects_outside.how: The Matrix beating has a direct, worsening cost on Neo's actual body, raising the clock the crew must answer.

events.turns_on: Neo's refusal to accept the death Smith authors — 'He is not ready to die. My name is Neo' — which converts belief into will and makes the impossible upward hurl possible; and Smith's survival of the train, which re-establishes him as unkillable and reopens the chase.
events.boundary_reason: This is the final scene; the duel, the choke-hold by the third-rail, and the train's arrival that lets Neo break free and flee form one continuous fight-and-escape unit.

events.title: The ship detects the sentinels

events.action: detection and escalation to imminent attack; the crew shifts from puzzling over a lost signal to preparing a weapon they cannot yet use.

events.title: Neo's flight to the exit
events.summary: Neo is cut off from his crew and hunted through the city by Agents who multiply from the crowd. He steals a phone to re-establish contact with the hovercraft, and Tank, guided by Trinity's panic, locates a hard-line exit in a hotel room. Neo fights through a tightening cordon — alleys, a market, a dead end, an apartment block — with Tank calling every turn, and reaches the alley that leads to the exit, alive but wounded, with the Agents still in close pursuit.
events.action: A chase that converts Neo from isolated and uncontactable to reconnected and guided, and drives him from open flight to a specific, crew-located exit — while the Agents escalate from pursuit to live fire and near-capture.

registers.entry: Running loose through the city, weaving away from pedestrians and potential Agents.
registers.change: Traces a continuous escape route — street, alley, market, dead-end alley, apartment staircase, hall, window, fire escape, into the exit alley — each leg directed by Tank's commands.
registers.exit: In the alley at the end of the fire escape, charging for the exit at Wabash and Lake.

registers.entry: Out of contact and unaccounted for after the others lost him.

registers.exit: Under active guidance from Tank — no longer running blind.

registers.exit: Still hunted and nearly captured, but uncaught and moving toward the exit.

registers.exit: Knows the target and is being fed the route in real time.

events.title: The sentinels attack; the EMP is readied
events.summary: As the crew prepares to make the final call, the sentinels arrive and physically assault the Nebuchadnezzar. The crew shifts from completing the call to arming the ship's EMP defence, and Morpheus commits to the belief that the one still in the Matrix will reach the exit.
events.action: The event converts a moment of focused preparation into an active assault, forcing the crew from offensive action (making the call) into defensive reaction (arming the EMP) while the ship is struck.

events.title: Trinity's Declaration and Neo's Return
events.summary: With the Nebuchadnezzar dead and Morpheus weeping as he reaches for the EMP switch, Trinity leans over Neo's body and breaks her silence, declaring the Oracle's prophecy that she would fall in love with the One and insisting he cannot be dead because she loves him. She kisses him in full belief that he will feel it. The declaration is answered: on the hotel hardline, a man's eyes snap open, and back on the Nebuchadnezzar the monitors roar back to life as Neo returns, turning the crew's grief into the recognition of a miracle.

events.title: Neo Sees the Code and Destroys Smith
events.summary: Neo's resurrection is converted from a private miracle into a public, irreversible fact of power. In the HALL he halts the Agents' volley, perceives the Matrix as code, and on the ship's MAIN DECK this registers on the monitors as proof that confirms Morpheus's prophecy. Returning to the HALL, Neo destroys Agent Smith from within and drives the remaining Agents to their first-ever flight — ending the Agents' era of invulnerability and repositioning Neo from hunted anomaly to dominant force.

affects_outside.how: Smith is destroyed and the surviving Agents flee, ending the Agents' era of invulnerability; the pursuit's hunters are now afraid and on the run, which reopens the story from escape to proclamation and counter-attack.
Morpheus's prophecy is visually confirmed as fact aboard the ship, hardening his conviction and setting the crew's stance toward Neo.
The event is interrupted by an explosion that shakes the entire ship — a new external threat lands as the moment of triumph closes.

events.turns_on: Neo's resurrection (ev-035 and the kiss/resurrection arc in sc-213–215) — the power he displays here is the returned-One state made public.
events.boundary_reason: Halting the bullets, seeing the code, and killing Smith while the other Agents flee are one unit of Neo's awakening to his power; it ends when the focus returns to the doomed main deck, a different situation.

events.title: The EMP Fires
events.summary: As sentinels overrun the ship and close on the crew, Trinity drives the evacuation from the deck, Neo reaches the exit line from the Matrix, and Morpheus turns the key on her command, discharging the EMP and killing every sentinel in the overflow pit. The ship is left silent and intact, the machine assault ended.

Preserved — without the EMP the descending sentinels would have killed Morpheus and overrun the deck; the discharge removes that immediate threat.

events.turns_on: Trinity's command ('Now!') timing Morpheus's key-turn to the exact moment Neo/'he' reach their exit phones and a sentinel closes on Morpheus.
events.boundary_reason: Trinity's cry, Morpheus turning the key as the sentinel descends, and the sentinels falling dead in the overflow pit are one continuous action — the firing and effect of the EMP — resolved before the ship goes still.

events.title: Revival and Neo's Promise
events.summary: Neo returns to life aboard the hovercraft and reconnects with Trinity, then—his voice carried over a phone line into the Matrix—broadcasts a public declaration that he is done running and that the world inside the Matrix can be changed from within by freeing one's mind. The event turns a private resurrection into an open, outward-facing promise aimed at everyone still asleep.
events.action: declaration_after_resurrection_and_outward_call_to_awaken_others

It spends the pursuit that defined the film by declaring it over and leaving the question of continued fighting to his listeners.

events.turns_on: Neo's revival and his decision to broadcast a public promise rather than remain hidden.
events.boundary_reason: This single scene is a pivot: the ship is quiet, Neo revives and reunites with Trinity, and his phone broadcast reframes the whole conflict — a self-contained resolution beat distinct from the escape that follows.

events.title: Neo Takes Flight
events.summary: Neo ends a phone call, steps out of the booth, and takes off into the sky, accelerating past the camera faster than a bullet. This is a closing image, not a turning point: it converts the film's final beat into a demonstration of Neo's now-complete mastery over the Matrix.
events.action: Neo exits a phone booth, puts on sunglasses, and launches into flight, rising until the city is far below and then blasting past the camera at superhuman speed.

state_triples.reading: The flight is a visual thesis statement: Neo, having been 'reborn' as the One, now operates the Matrix as freely as its architects. The sunglasses and billowing coat frame him as a superhero, closing the film on an image of total mastery and open-ended possibility.

affects_outside.what: The film's closing image / franchise trajectory.
affects_outside.how: Establishes flight as part of Neo's established capability, setting the baseline power level and iconography (sunglasses, coat, superhuman speed) that later installments build on. It changes nothing in the immediate plot — the war with the machines is unresolved — but locks in Neo's public mythos as the One who can fly.

events.turns_on: Neo's demonstrated command of the Matrix's physics (already won in prior scenes) is here externalised as flight.
events.boundary_reason: The final image — Neo hanging up, stepping out, and flying above the city — is a standalone closing beat that answers a new question (what the One now does) rather than continuing the revival scene.
